video_title: Jaylen Wells Walk-Off Interview | Grizzlies vs. Clippers

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Wells
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Wells on Memphis Grizzlies' second-half defensive intensity
quotes.excerpt: we were very, very good defensive half, just had to play both sides of the ball.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Jaylen, they climbed back there at the end of the second quarter, but you took it back to them again in the third and the fourth. What was the difference in the second half?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Wells
text_blocks.text: I think we had to get our offense going. We were very, very good defensive half, just had to play both sides of the ball.

quotes.social_post: Jaylen Wells on the Grizzlies second half surge against the Clippers: We were very good on the defensive end, we just had to play both sides of the ball.

structured.context: Jaylen Wells discusses the Grizzlies' defensive intensity and offensive performance in the second half against the Clippers.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Wells
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Wells on Grizzlies' ability to wear down opponents
quotes.excerpt: a lot of it is just wearing out the other team. We play a very intense game.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: As far as second halves, you guys have been very successful in second halves. What leads to that?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Wells
text_blocks.text: I think a lot of it is just wearing out the other team. We play a very intense game, picking up full court, being disruptive, so I don't think a lot of teams can keep up with that.

quotes.social_post: Jaylen Wells says the Grizzlies success in second halves comes down to wearing out the opponent: We play a very intense game, picking up full court, being disruptive, so I do not think a lot of teams can keep up with that.

structured.context: Jaylen Wells explains why the Grizzlies are successful in second halves by wearing down their opponents with intense, full-court pressure.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Wells
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Wells on Grizzlies' ball movement and depth
quotes.excerpt: we have a lot of weapons. Even with guys out, I think it shows our depth.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: I know you guys talk so much about ball movement, and in that third quarter, nine assists on 12 made baskets. How important is that, especially the last couple of games the assist numbers weren't there?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Wells
text_blocks.text: It's very important. We have a lot of weapons. Even with guys out, I think it shows our depth, shows that anyone can have the ball in their hands and make a play.

quotes.social_post: Jaylen Wells on the Grizzlies ball movement: We have a lot of weapons. Even with guys out, I think it shows our depth, shows that anyone can have the ball in their hands and make a play.

structured.context: Jaylen Wells highlights the importance of ball movement and the team's depth despite having players out of the lineup.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Wells
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Wells on upcoming rematch against Minnesota Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: we just got to play our game. That's it. I think if we play our game we'll win.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Minnesota ended up winning tonight against Oklahoma City. So Friday's game comes down to the winner wins the group. You played them less than a week ago. What did you learn from that game that needs to be better this time around?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Wells
text_blocks.text: Defensively, I think we started off really good. We just got to play our game. That's it. I think if we play our game we'll win.

quotes.social_post: Jaylen Wells on the upcoming rematch against Minnesota: Defensively, I think we started off really good. We just got to play our game. That is it. I think if we play our game we will win.

structured.context: Jaylen Wells discusses the upcoming rematch against the Minnesota Timberwolves and the need for the team to play their own game.
